All requirements have been implemented and committed to a new branch `batch-durable`.

### Summary of Changes

1. **[`EventListener.BatchDurable`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ur6o7fwf/event.go#L956-L959) Callback**:
   - Added `BatchDurable func(BatchDurableInfo)` to [`EventListener`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ur6o7fwf/event.go#L950) in [event.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ur6o7fwf/event.go).
   - Created [`BatchDurableInfo`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ur6o7fwf/event.go#L53-L64) carrying `JobID`, `SeqNum`, `Err`, `ApplyDuration`, `SyncDuration`, `CorrelationID`, `BatchSize`, and `KeyCount`.
   - Wired through [`TeeEventListener`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ur6o7fwf/event.go#L1254) and [`MakeLoggingEventListener`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ur6o7fwf/event.go#L1168).
   - Configured `CommitCorrelationID uint64` on [`WriteOptions`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ur6o7fwf/options.go#L405-L412) in [options.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ur6o7fwf/options.go).

2. **Commit Pipeline Integration**:
   - In [`commitPipeline.Commit`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ur6o7fwf/commit.go#L298) and [`d.applyInternal`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ur6o7fwf/db.go#L792):
     - Captured positive wall-clock durations for `ApplyDuration` and `SyncDuration`.
     - Fired `BatchDurable` exactly once per `Sync` commit after the WAL sync finishes (including failures and `ApplyNoSyncWait`/[`Batch.SyncWait`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ur6o7fwf/batch.go#L1706)).
     - Ensured non-sync commits and `DisableWAL` never trigger `BatchDurable`.

3. **Durability Wait & Query APIs**:
   - Implemented in [durability.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ur6o7fwf/durability.go):
     - [`WaitForDurability`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ur6o7fwf/durability.go#L480) / [`WaitForDurabilityContext`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ur6o7fwf/durability.go#L487): blocks until sequence number is durable; zero succeeds after any commit.
     - [`WaitForDurabilityBatch`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ur6o7fwf/durability.go#L493) / [`WaitForDurabilityBatchContext`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ur6o7fwf/durability.go#L501): blocks until every sequence number in a slice is durable; `nil`/empty returns `nil`.
     - [`WaitForJobDurability`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ur6o7fwf/durability.go#L526) / [`WaitForJobDurabilityContext`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ur6o7fwf/durability.go#L532): waits by callback job ID; jobs outside the retention window return an error containing `"expired"`; never-seen and zero IDs return an error containing `"unknown"`.
     - [`DurableState`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ur6o7fwf/durability.go#L538): returns `(base.SeqNum, error)` representing the highest durable sequence number and first latched error.
     - [`DurabilityNotify`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ur6o7fwf/durability.go#L547): returns a pre-filled receive-only channel bounded against excess callers.
     - [`DurabilityStats`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ur6o7fwf/durability.go#L554): returns [`DurabilityStats`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ur6o7fwf/durability.go#L60) starting at zero values; `PendingWaiters` accurately tracks currently blocked wait goroutines.
     - Durability/close errors take precedence over context cancellation; all waiters unblock on DB close; all wait APIs and `DurabilityNotify` return `nil` immediately when `DisableWAL: true`.

4. **Metrics**:
   - Added `DurableCommitCount uint64` and `DurableCommitDuration time.Duration` to [`Metrics`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ur6o7fwf/metrics.go#L382-L387) in [metrics.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ur6o7fwf/metrics.go), accumulated only when `BatchDurable` is configured.

5. **Testing**:
   - Added unit test suite in [durability_test.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ur6o7fwf/durability_test.go) covering all new callbacks, metrics accumulation, context cancellation precedence, error propagation, DB close unblocking, and subscription limits.
